summary: Israeli forces are conducting intensive strike operations across southern Lebanon with evacuation warnings issued for Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and northern Golan Heights. A stabbing attack in Samaria resulted in one terrorist eliminated and another injured, while Israel warns of potential large-scale operation against Palestinian Authority structures in Judea and Samaria. Iranian Major General Mohsen Rezaei announced a new restricted maritime zone near the Strait of Hormuz, and Houthi forces are losing ground in Yemen with government forces capturing positions near Taiz.
key_points: IDF issued evacuation warnings for southern Lebanon residents as intensive strike operations commenced, with explosions expected in Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and northern Golan Heights. (Source: @pkpoi/143869)
Israeli forces conducted vehicle strikes in Raman, south Lebanon and in the Hamad junction west of Gaza City. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94321, @lelotsenzura/94317)
Security forces eliminated the terrorist responsible for the stabbing attack in Samaria and are searching for an additional suspect. (Source: @New_security8200/203666)
Defense Minister Katz stated Israel will launch comprehensive war against Palestinian Authority leadership and terror infrastructure in Judea and Samaria if needed. (Source: @New_security8200/203667)
Iran's Major General Rezaei announced a new restricted zone will be declared outside the Strait of Hormuz for uncoordinated vessels. (Source: @presstv/205844)
Yemeni government forces captured Labanat camp east of Hazm and repulsed Houthi militias from Naqil and Jabal Al-Koura positions near Taiz. (Source: @shin_persian/9538, @shin_persian/9531)
Mohsen Rezaei referenced Iran's right to respond to US strikes on a wedding in Kuhestak, stating they tested an anti-ship missile over a US warship. (Source: @kianmeli1/91597)
Saudi Aramco facilities in Jizan were reportedly attacked, with the strike similar in scope to an attack approximately one month prior. (Source: @asafroz/53175)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli military operations intensified across Lebanon with strikes targeting multiple locations while evacuation warnings were issued for northern Israel. Security incidents in Judea and Samaria resulted in a stabbing attack with casualties, while Defense Minister Katz threatened comprehensive military action against Palestinian Authority structures. Iranian military officials announced a new maritime restricted zone near the Strait of Hormuz and referenced anti-ship missile tests over US naval assets.

points: Iran's Major General Mohsen Rezaei announced that a new restricted zone will be declared outside the Strait of Hormuz in coming days, warning that any vessel entering without coordination with Tehran will be placed on an Iranian watch list. (Source: @presstv/205844)

Rezaei stated Iran's right to respond to US attacks on a wedding in Kuhestak is preserved, and revealed they tested an Iranian anti-ship missile over a US warship 48 hours prior. (Source: @kianmeli1/91597)

Trump posted AI-generated images showing US fighter jets attacking Kharg Island on Truth Social, alongside charts claiming Iran's currency has collapsed and the country faces hyperinflation. (Source: @VahidOnline/78261)
Trump described Iran as becoming a failed state while publishing charts showing falling oil exports and increasing dollar-to-rial exchange rates. (Source: @mamlekate/104352)
An Iranian delegation from the Armed Forces General Staff arrived in Qatar to investigate the status of three Iranian pilots held in Qatari custody since the war. (Source: @asafroz/53165)
Iranian security forces continue monitoring domestic dissent amid economic pressures, with gasoline prices set to increase to 10,000 tomans. (Source: @kianmeli1/91594)

Defense Minister Israel Katz ordered the IDF to prepare for a comprehensive war against senior Palestinian Authority officials and terror infrastructure in Judea and Samaria if attacks similar to October 7 occur. (Source: @New_security8200/203667)
IDF Arabic spokesperson issued evacuation warnings before strikes in Dir Zahrani, south Lebanon, with the targeted building subsequently attacked. (Source: @New_security8200/203664)
Israeli forces conducted a massive demolition operation in Mansouri, southern Lebanon, and carried out strikes on Nabatieh. (Source: @presstv/205846, @rodast_omiddana/80452)
Forces eliminated the terrorist responsible for the stabbing attack in Samaria and continue searching for an additional suspect who fled the scene. (Source: @New_security8200/203666)
IDF issued warnings of incoming strikes in Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and northern Golan Heights as part of a wave of attacks on Lebanon. (Source: @pkpoi/143879, @pkpoi/143869)

A stabbing attack occurred in Binyamin region where a terrorist arrived in a vehicle, stabbed a Jewish victim, and fled; the injured person is in moderate-to-serious condition receiving treatment. (Source: @almogboker78/18145)
An IDF report confirmed an attempted stabbing terror attack in the Awusarin area of Samaria district, with forces responding to the scene. (Source: @idf_telegram/25073)
A vehicle strike was conducted at Hamad junction west of Gaza City. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94317)
A seriously injured stabbing victim from the Samaria attack, a teenager, was brought to Rabin Medical Center in moderate-to-serious condition. (Source: @pkpoi/143876)

An alert was activated at Farag post near Ramim Ridge following an event in depth Lebanon on a shared预警 layer with the post, confirmed by IDF as not a security incident. (Source: @yediotnews25/134763)
Israeli army issued evacuation warnings for south Lebanon residents as military operations intensify, with people fleeing the area. (Source: @kianmeli1/91601)
Vehicle strikes were conducted in Raman, south Lebanon, and IDF forces struck targets in Nabatieh. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94321, @rodast_omiddana/80452)
Israeli forces carried out a massive demolition operation in Mansouri, southern Lebanon. (Source: @presstv/205846)
An IDF vehicle was struck by an explosive device in the Yellow Line area, targeting an IDF engineering vehicle. (Source: @almogboker78/18144)
Explosions were reported from IDF strikes with sounds expected in Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly northern Golan Heights. (Source: @pkpoi/143869)

Iraqi judicial authorities issued orders from the Public Prosecutor for the custody of two individuals involved in assaults on Iraqi students, summoning them to security authorities. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89564)
Iraqi judicial investigations continue to identify additional individuals involved in the assault on Iraqi students. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89564)
Russian authorities closed the German consulate in Saint Petersburg. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89555)

Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Jizan city were attacked this morning, with the strike reportedly similar in scope to an attack approximately one month prior that partially shut down refinery production. (Source: @asafroz/53175)
Firefighting operations on an oil tanker attacked near Kharg Island have been completed, with all crew members reportedly unharmed and no oil leakage detected. (Source: @SharghDaily/182374)
Various inspection, engineering, and technical teams were dispatched to assess the damaged tanker for relocation and transfer decisions. (Source: @SharghDaily/182374)

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level remains elevated with Israeli forces conducting intensive operations across Lebanon while facing potential escalation in Judea and Samaria. Defense Minister Katz's explicit warning of comprehensive military action against Palestinian Authority structures represents a significant policy shift that could trigger widespread violence. Iranian maritime restrictions near the Strait of Hormuz create additional navigational hazards for commercial vessels. The combination of Houthi territorial losses in Yemen and Iranian anti-ship missile tests suggests expanding conflict dynamics across multiple regional theaters.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese civilians are fleeing south Lebanon following Israeli evacuation warnings as strike operations intensify. Iranian officials are maintaining a defensive posture regarding maritime security while referencing retaliation rights for US strikes on a wedding. The Palestinian Authority faces unprecedented threats from Israeli leadership regarding potential military action against its institutions. Regional actors including Qatar continue serving as intermediaries for Iranian military personnel matters.
sections.intelligence_notes: The elimination of the Samaria terrorist demonstrates IDF operational capability in Judea and Samaria, while the search for the additional suspect indicates potential ongoing threat. Iranian anti-ship missile testing over US naval assets represents a significant capability demonstration. Houthi losses in Yemen to government forces suggest potential compensatory aggression through regional attacks. Israeli military operations in Lebanon appear coordinated across multiple locations simultaneously, indicating pre-planned strike packages.
